text:
Find service failures and control the services this instance permits. Inspect status and logs, then start, stop or reload a selected unit. Start with failed or status; changes stay within the configured scope and require the appropriate role.
list [type]: Find loaded units, including inactive ones. Optionally select a unit type.
  type (service|timer|socket|mount|path|target|slice|scope|automount|swap|device): Optional unit type
timers: Check timers' last and next scheduled runs.
failed: Find failed units.
status <unit>: Inspect the status of one unit.
logs [unit] [lines] [since <age>]: Read recent journal output, capped at 256 KiB. Without a unit, the call still respects this instance's configured unit scope.; role: operate|admin
  lines (int): 1..1000; default 100
  since (string): Positive age, 1..99999 followed by m, h or d; text uses since <age>
[destructive] start <unit>: Start a unit allowed by this instance's configured scope.; role: operate|admin
[destructive] restart <unit>: Stop and start a unit allowed by this instance's configured scope.; role: operate|admin
[destructive] reload <unit>: Ask a unit within this instance's configured scope to reload.; role: operate|admin
[destructive] stop <unit>: Stop a unit allowed by this instance's configured scope.; role: admin
[destructive] enable <unit>: Enable a unit allowed by this instance's configured scope.; role: admin
[destructive] disable <unit>: Disable a unit allowed by this instance's configured scope.; role: admin

Arguments
unit (string): Exact fully qualified Linux unit name, for example nginx.service

Examples
agent-bus call '#systemd@parf.us' 'list service'
agent-bus call '#systemd@parf.us' 'timers'
agent-bus call '#systemd@parf.us' 'failed'
agent-bus call '#systemd@parf.us' 'status agent-bus-web.service'
agent-bus call '#systemd@parf.us' 'logs agent-bus-web.service 5 since 1h'

v<version> · PolyForm-NC · parf.dev/agent-bus/
Docs: https://github.com/parf/ai-agent-bus/blob/main/docs/agents/systemd.md
